question: Who was the first musician to be awarded the prestigious Bharat Ratna, India’s highest civilian honour?
solution:
The correct answer is **__MS Subbulakshmi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was the first musician to be awarded the prestigious **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian honour.
 
• **Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi** (16 September 1916 – 11 December 2004) was an Indian Carnatic singer from Madurai, Tamil Nadu. 
 
• She was also awarded with the Ramon Magsaysay award, Asia's highest civilian award in 1974.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian award in India.
 
• The Bharat Ratna award is presented by the president of India.
 
• The first Bharat Ratna award was awarded to politician **C.** **Rajagopalachari**, philosopher Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, and scientist CV Raman in the year 1954.
 
• **Indira Gandhi **was the first female Prime Minister of India and was conferred with the Bharat Ratna in 1971. She was elected as the president of the Congress party in 1959.
